priorEvidence: v1/v2 contracts, validators, drivers, reports and failures retained unchanged; no backfilling or cross-version timing acceptance
hosts: relocated Player trusted SDK within actual runner
sampling: one complete fresh development invocation per configuration after integration; retain failed invocations, no timing-based selection
scope: trusted product SDK frame callbacks and report reads, not ordinary scheduler or paced target frame intervals

gpu.raw: both current and last-resolved slots per domain; warm baseline plus every measured report
gpu.dedup: only last-resolved Valid/Disjoint/Invalid entries by generation/domain/sequence; every repeated source must agree in state, origin, resource, revision and duration
gpu.coverage: separate valid measured/outside-window sources, invalid resolved sources, current state counts, admission sequence jumps, unobserved resolution sequence slots and unobserved tail slots
gpu.gapMeaning: sequence slots not observed in a resolved snapshot; may include abandoned work, not a fabricated count of valid lost timings; warm prefix excluded by baseline; no final GPU drain
gpu.aggregation: domains not summed; pending/invalid/absent are not zero-cost valid samples; one retained result does not guarantee full coverage

memory: unchanged signed raw heap validity, last-GC diagnostic supplement, process private/working set; no native-by-subtraction estimate
rawPreservation: CreateNew raw prefix before validation; post-loop diagnostic failure preserves completed rows; persistence failure reported alongside original exception
functionalGates: one actual committed quantum per row
